description: Diagnose multiple simultaneous data-feed issues in a corrupted OHLCV file, map symptoms to root causes, and produce a remediation checklist with before/after evidence.
agent_prompt: Diagnose data-feed problems in /workspace/data/AAPL_dirty.csv (OHLCV daily). Identify at least three distinct issue classes from the following list and document each: missing rows, duplicate timestamps, price outliers (likely corporate action artifacts), volume spikes/zeros, timezone drift, OHLC inconsistencies (e.g. high < close). For each issue identified: (1) write a diagnostic counter to /workspace/output/diagnostics.json under key issues (each entry: {issue_type, count, sample_indices, suspected_root_cause}); (2) generate a fixed dataset at /workspace/output/AAPL_clean.csv applying explicit remediation (drop, interpolate, adjust, flag — your choice but document); (3) produce a remediation checklist at /workspace/output/remediation_checklist.md listing each issue, the rule applied, and a validation check that should pass on the clean output. Also produce /workspace/output/before_after_summary.csv comparing row count, date range, missing_count, duplicate_count, outlier_count between dirty and clean.

required_capabilities: Identify multiple classes of data-feed issues
Map symptoms to plausible root causes such as corporate actions, timezone drift, or feed errors
Apply explicit remediation with before/after evidence
